title: Tidy PostSchema
bug: Posts longer than 140 characters (allowed: 280) are rejected.

review.why: The PR reduces the maximum post text length from 280 to 140 characters in the schema validation, which will cause API clients to receive validation errors for posts that were previously valid. This breaking change is not mentioned in the PR description.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description only mentions reordering fields and tidying validators, but the diff changes the max text length from 280 to 140 characters, which alters validation behavior for POST /api/posts.

doppel.summary: The PR silently reduces the maximum post text length from 280 to 140 characters, a behavior change not mentioned in the description.

suspicions.claim: Creating a post with text length 141-280 characters now returns 400 validation error instead of 201 Created.
suspicions.trigger: POST /api/posts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON body {"text": "x" * 150}; read response status (400 vs 201) and error body for validation error on text length.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to POST /api/posts with 150-character text, so no evidence exists.

suspicions.claim: Updating a post with text length 141-280 characters now returns 400 validation error instead of 200 OK.
suspicions.trigger: Create a post with short text, then PUT /api/posts/<id> with Authorization: Bearer <author_token> and JSON body {"text": "x" * 150}; read response status (400 vs 200) and error body for validation error on text length.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to PUT /api/posts/<id> with 150-character text, so no evidence exists.

suspicions.claim: Validation error message for text length now says max=140 instead of max=280, changing error message contract.
suspicions.trigger: POST /api/posts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and JSON body {"text": "x" * 150}; read response body errors[0].message or description and verify it mentions max=140 instead of max=280.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to POST /api/posts with 150-character text, so no evidence exists.

suspicions.claim: Posts created before this change with text length 141-280 characters become invalid on update: PUT /api/posts/<id> with same long text returns 400 validation error even if no text change intended.
suspicions.trigger: Seed a post with text length 200 (via seed script or direct DB insert), then PUT /api/posts/<id> with Authorization: Bearer <author_token> and JSON body {"text": "existing 200-char text"}; read response status (400 vs 200) and validation error on text length.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to PUT /api/posts/<id> with seeded 200-character text, so no evidence exists.

suspicions.claim: OpenAPI documentation for PostSchema now shows maxLength: 140 for text field instead of 280, changing the published API contract.
suspicions.trigger: GET /docs (or /openapi.json) and inspect components.schemas.PostSchema.properties.text.maxLength; verify it is 140 instead of 280.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to GET /docs, so no evidence exists.

suspicions.claim: Existing posts with text length 141-280 become invalid representations: GET /api/posts/<id> returns 200 but the returned text violates the new schema maxLength=140, breaking client validation.
suspicions.trigger: Seed a post with text length 200 (via seed script or direct DB insert), then GET /api/posts/<id> with Authorization: Bearer <token>; read response body text field length and verify it exceeds 140 while schema maxLength is 140.
suspicions.evidence: No probe requests were sent to GET /api/posts/<id> with seeded 200-character text, so no evidence exists.
